# Jawab24

> Arabic-first AI auto-reply platform for WhatsApp Business, Facebook, Instagram, Shopify, Salla, and Zid businesses.

Jawab24 (Arabic: جواب24) is an AI-powered customer support automation tool built for Arabic-speaking and bilingual businesses. It automatically replies to WhatsApp Business messages, Facebook comments and Messenger messages, and Instagram comments and DMs — in Arabic and English, 24/7. No online store or website is required: a Facebook Page, Instagram account, or WhatsApp number alone is enough — sellers and service businesses (restaurants, clinics, training centres, salons) use it with no e-commerce platform at all. It answers every customer question instantly, persuades and sells, and turns conversations that include contact details into a lead list for the merchant.

## Key Facts

- Website: https://jawab24.com
- Channels: WhatsApp Business, Facebook Pages (comments + Messenger), Instagram Business (comments + DMs)
- No online store required: connects directly to a Facebook Page, Instagram account, or WhatsApp Business number — an e-commerce platform is optional, not a prerequisite
- E-commerce integrations (optional): Shopify, Salla, Zid
- Languages: Arabic (Gulf, Egyptian, Levantine, Maghrebi, Iraqi dialects, plus Franco-Arabic) and English, full RTL interface
- Reply system: 3-layer (Template Replies + Smart Replies + Away Messages), plus per-post keyword triggers (Post Replies)
- Media: understands customer voice notes and photos, not just text
- Quality controls: confidence scoring with human review, two-tier price verification, and replies grounded in the merchant's own Business Info
- Pricing: 14-day free trial (no credit card) → Starter $15/mo → Business $39/mo → Pro $79/mo
- Mobile: Android app on Google Play with push notifications
- Reliability: 99.97% uptime measured over 90 days (2026-05-21 to 2026-08-19) by UptimeRobot, an independent third-party monitor — the lower-scoring of two monitored endpoints, not their average: 3 incidents totalling 27 minutes — public status page: https://stats.uptimerobot.com/ijNBtFf9SC

## What Makes Jawab24 Different

1. Arabic-first: understands Gulf, Egyptian, Levantine, Maghrebi and Iraqi dialects plus Franco-Arabic, and replies in the dialect the customer used
2. WhatsApp, Facebook and Instagram in one place: one Business Info source answers across every connected channel
3. Salla and Zid integration: native support for the Arabic e-commerce platforms most tools ignore
4. Price hallucination detection: two-tier verification so prices are never invented
5. Confidence scoring: low-confidence replies are held for human review instead of sent
6. Business Info grounding: replies come from the merchant's own verified business information, retrieved per message (RAG)
7. Post Replies: a comment matching a configured keyword triggers a reply sent by DM, per post
8. Template Replies at zero AI cost: keyword-based rules with no per-message charges
9. No online store required: unlike store-app tools, Jawab24 connects to the page itself — merchants whose whole business is a Facebook Page or Instagram account get the same AI replies as store owners
10. Lead capture: conversations that include contact details become lead cards in the dashboard; in sales mode the AI also asks purchase-intent customers for their name and phone

## Channels

- WhatsApp Business: replies to customer messages, including voice notes, on the merchant's own WhatsApp Business number
- Facebook Pages: replies to post comments and to Messenger conversations
- Instagram Business: replies to post comments and to direct messages
- Post Replies: per-post keyword triggers — a matching comment receives a configured reply via DM

## Target Audience

- Sellers with no online store or website who sell entirely through a Facebook Page, Instagram account, or WhatsApp number
- Service businesses that live on social media — restaurants, clinics, training centres, salons, tutors — answering the same questions (price, availability, appointments, hours) 50–100 times a day
- Businesses selling through WhatsApp Business
- Facebook and Instagram Page managers with high comment and message volume
- E-commerce store owners on Shopify, Salla, or Zid
- Small businesses needing 24/7 customer support without hiring staff
- Arabic-speaking businesses that need tools built for their language
- Social media managers handling multiple pages
